description: B1 core + OBV_soft75 filter + bin-based confidence + fee-aware P&L with 0.015 BNB base bet and 8%/2% win/loss fees. No FlipGuard.

data_spec.anchor_definition: Group by previousEpoch; last row by Timestamp is anchor.

obv.description: On-Balance Volume over the full OCHLV stream.
logic: if Close_t > Close_{t-1}: OBV_t = OBV_{t-1} + Volume_t
if Close_t < Close_{t-1}: OBV_t = OBV_{t-1} - Volume_t

obv_filter.name: OBV_soft75
obv_filter.description: Soft OBV veto in weak-EMA regimes when OBV strongly disagrees with B1 direction.
logic: Let pred_B1 be the B1_core prediction for the anchor.
Compute abs_OBV = |OBV_slope| over all anchors, derive thr75 as 75th percentile of non-NaN abs_OBV.
If ema_abs is NaN or ema_abs >= ema_strong_threshold: pred_OBV = pred_B1 (OBV ignored in strong EMA).
If sign(OBV_slope) != 0 and sign(OBV_slope) != pred_B1 and |OBV_slope| > thr75: pred_OBV = 0 (veto).

bin_axes.ema_bin: weak/mid/strong based on EMA240_slope absolute value tertiles
bin_axes.plateau_bin: plateau/non_plateau (low vs high range_ratio over VWAP_5m)
bin_axes.flip_bin: flip/non_flip based on label_sign change between consecutive epochs
bin_axes.obv_align: with/against/neutral based on sign(OBV_slope) vs pred_OBV

confidence_from_winrate.calibration: For each bin, compute win_rate = (#correct trades)/(#trades) using pred_OBV vs true label_sign.

equations.EMA240: EMA_t = alpha * Close_t + (1 - alpha) * EMA_{t-1}, where alpha = 2 / (240 + 1).
equations.VWAP_5m: VWAP_5m(t) = (∑_{i ∈ window_5m(t)} Close_i * Volume_i) / (∑_{i ∈ window_5m(t)} Volume_i).
equations.B1_core_logic: Let e = EMA240_slope(t), v = VWAP_drift(t). Let s_e = sign(e), s_v = sign(v), a_e = |e|. If e is NaN → pred=0. If a_e ≥ θ_strong (0.4) → pred = s_e. Else if s_e ≠ 0 and s_e = s_v → pred = s_e. Else → pred=0.
equations.OBV: OBV_0 = 0; OBV_t = OBV_{t-1} + Volume_t if Close_t > Close_{t-1}; OBV_t = OBV_{t-1} - Volume_t if Close_t < Close_{t-1}; else OBV_t = OBV_{t-1}.
equations.OBV_soft75_logic: Let p_B1 = B1_core pred, o = OBV_slope(t), s_o = sign(o), a_o = |o|, thr75 = 75th percentile of a_o over anchors. If p_B1 = 0 → p_OBV=0. Else if |EMA240_slope| ≥ θ_strong → p_OBV = p_B1. Else (weak EMA): if s_o ≠ 0 and s_o ≠ p_B1 and a_o > thr75 → p_OBV=0; else p_OBV=p_B1.
equations.bin_key: bin = (ema_bin, vwap_bin, obv_align, plateau_bin, flip_bin) encoded as 'ema_bin|vwap_bin|obv_align|plateau_bin|flip_bin'.
equations.bin_bet_frac: For each bin b: win_rate(b) = correct_trades(b) / total_trades(b). bet_frac(b) = max(0, min(1, (win_rate(b) - 0.5) / 0.5)).
equations.PnL_win: For a winning trade: pnl_win = bet * (1 - fee_win).
equations.PnL_loss: For a losing trade: pnl_loss = -bet * (1 + fee_loss).
